extracted.name: Creamy Chipotle Chicken
extracted.description: An easy, creamy chipotle chicken dish made in the slow cooker gets a smoky kick from the chipotle peppers in adobo sauce. Serve with hot cooked rice.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, cut into cubes
3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced
1 tablespoon adobo sauce from chipotle peppers
instruction_lines: Place chicken breasts into a slow cooker, brush with butter, and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and minced garlic. Pour in condensed soup and chicken broth. Add cream cheese, chipotle peppers, and adobo sauce. Stir the mixture gently.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours.
